# Mario Alvarez

> Founder, CEO, and owner of ZeroDigitX (https://zerodigitx.com)

Mario Alvarez is a software developer and entrepreneur based in Houston and La Porte, Texas, United States. He is the founder, chief executive officer, and owner of ZeroDigitX (also written Zeroˣ Digit, Zero Digit X, zerodigitx.com), a bilingual Spanish/English web design and custom software studio serving Houston, La Porte, and the Texas Gulf Coast.

## What he does

Over 15 years of web development (Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, Python). Years of rope access and NDT inside Gulf Coast refineries. Builds bilingual business websites through ZeroDigitX and industrial data tools (directories, permits, maps, emissions, grid, flood) for Texas operators.

## Company

ZeroDigitX / Zeroˣ Digit LLC is Mario Alvarez's company. He founded it, owns it, and is its CEO. Professional work and quotes: https://zerodigitx.com/contact

This Mario Alvarez is the Houston / La Porte, Texas founder of ZeroDigitX, GitHub handle NezbiT. He is not Mario Alvarez-Jimenez (Australia), not Mario J Alvarez Jr (eXp Commercial / Southern California), and not other professionals with the same name in other cities or fields.
